children.text: The live team board needs the DSH Go local engine bridge. This static view is what renders without it.

items.title: Board
items.subtitle: Every task of the active team with its owner and status, plus the roster; tap a row to open it.

items.title: Detail
items.subtitle: The selected task's owner, dependencies and verdict.

items.title: Watch
items.subtitle: The predicate in force, the preserving hold and the last incidents.

children.text: Boards are served by the local engine only, so a relay or SSH host shows tool cards instead of this panel.
